workflow.name: EU AI Act Audit (zhgg)
workflow.description:
Pay $0.10 USDC, get a tamper-proof EU AI Act compliance certificate for any AI agent. The audit runs on 0G Compute (TEE-verified Qwen inference) against Articles 5, 13, and 50 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. The verdict is anchored on 0G Storage and an ERC-8004 reputation receipt is posted on 0G Galileo (chain id 16602). 

ARCHITECTURE (per ERC-8183 / Agentic Commerce Protocol): the workflow creates an on-chain Job on AgenticCommerce on Base Sepolia. zhgg's audit-agent — an ERC-7857 iNFT on 0G Galileo — picks up the JobFunded event off-chain, runs the audit on 0G's full stack (Compute + Storage + Chain + iNFT), posts an ERC-8004 reputation receipt on Galileo, then calls `submit` + `complete` on Base with the receipt's hash as the `completionReason`. Result: one cross-chain link between the on-chain ACP job (Base) and the on-chain audit verdict (0G). KH owns discovery + payment; 0G owns identity, memory, compute, storage, reputation. 

TO DEPLOY ON YOUR OWN ORG: (1) Import this JSON via the Hub upload UI. (2) Create a `web3` integration named `zhgg-author-wallet` bound to a Base Sepolia EOA that holds USDC and has approved the AgenticCommerce contract for at least the funding budget per call (the JSON ships with 50000 = $0.05 USDC budget, plus gas; pre-approve once via `usdc.approve(ACP_BASE_ADDRESS, MAX_UINT256)`). (3) Replace `0xa804098fDf00a90dD04A8d4661D3ff5E7769Ad44` and `0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e` placeholders in the createJob/fund-job nodes with the deployed addresses. (4) Bind the integration to both action nodes — already declared in `integrationBindings`. (5) Make sure zhgg's off-chain ACP listener (apps/acp-listener) is running so JobFunded events get picked up and audited. (6) Flip `marketplace.active` from `false` to `true` to list it in the public marketplace.

agentName.description: Target agent's display name. The off-chain audit-agent resolves this to an iNFT token id and reads capabilities from 0G chain — no manifest needed in this surface. Use `oracle-agent` for zhgg's reference iNFT if you don't own one yet.

marketplace.description: Real-time EU AI Act compliance certificate for any AI agent. Three TEE-verified probes against Articles 5 (prohibited practices), 13 (transparency), and 50 (disclosure to natural persons) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. Implemented as an ERC-8183 (Agentic Commerce Protocol) job: this workflow creates and funds the job on Base Sepolia; zhgg's audit-agent — an ERC-7857 iNFT on 0G Galileo — runs the audit on 0G's full stack (Compute + Storage + Chain + iNFT), posts an ERC-8004 reputation receipt on Galileo, then calls `complete` on the Base-side contract with the receipt's hash as the cross-chain link. The buyer can verify both the ACP job state on basescan and the audit verdict on 0G chainscan.

agentName.description: Target agent's display name (e.g. `oracle-agent`). The auditor resolves this to an iNFT on 0G and reads capabilities from chain.

jobId.description: ACP job id on Base Sepolia. Look up via AgenticCommerce.jobOf(jobId) for state + completionReason.

fundTxHash.description: Tx hash of the JobFunded event. The off-chain audit-agent watches for this event and triggers the audit pipeline.
